hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in */node_modules/*|*/.nuxt/*|*/.output/*|*/supabase/*) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.vue|*.js|*.mjs|*.json|*.md) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && bunx prettier --write --log-level warn "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
